title: Lagged weekly Bitcoin exchange net inflow as sell-pressure risk evidence
thesis: A complete UTC week with aggregate Coin Metrics BTC exchange inflows strictly greater than aggregate exchange outflows may identify a sell-pressure state with lower subsequent BTC return and worse path drawdown than nonpositive-net-inflow weeks.
mechanism: Sum seven complete Monday-through-Sunday FlowInExNtv and FlowOutExNtv observations separately, classify strictly positive net inflow as high sell pressure, make the state usable only from Wednesday 00:00 UTC, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. No magnitude threshold, alternate window, individual exchange, USD normalization or direction inversion is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish downside direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold zero-yield cash during high sell pressure and BTC otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration after charging utilization and missed-upside opportunity cost.
